### Make a Difference - Today's Insight - March 11, 2024
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-11-2024.html
Passage: Esther 3:13-15
Points:
- Haman manipulated the Persian king into issuing an unchangeable edict commanding the total destruction of all Jewish people.
- The sudden, brutal decree threw the capital city of Susa into confusion and plunged the community into deep despair.
- Humanly speaking, the Jewish people faced an irrevocable death sentence with no apparent way of escape.
- Even in the darkest moments of helplessness, God is never asleep and remains sovereign over world events.
- God orchestrates history by preparing and using single individuals who are willing to take risks and stand in the gap.
